hook.text: "If you study, you pass. You didn't study. So you'll fail." But what about lucky guessing?

buildup.text: Denying the antecedent assumes that if the condition is false, the result must be false too.

discovery.text: "If it rains, the picnic is canceled. It didn't rain." The picnic could still be canceled—for other reasons.

twist.text: The valid reverse is modus tollens: deny Q to deny P. Denying P to deny Q is always invalid.

climax.text: Other paths to the same outcome exist. Removing one cause doesn't guarantee a different result.

punchline.text: One blocked path doesn't close all doors.

quiz.question: What does denying the antecedent incorrectly assume?
options: No other cause can produce the effect
